blocks.title: 🔤 Члены семьи
blocks.note: Нажми 🔊 и повтори. Сначала — база, ниже разберём step-, half-, -in-law и great-.

rows: -in-law — родство через брак: father-in-law = отец мужа или жены · brother-in-law = муж сестры или брат супруга.
step- — родство через повторный брак: stepmother = жена отца · stepsister = дочь отчима или мачехи.
half- — общий только один родитель: half-brother = брат по одному родителю.
great- — на поколение дальше: great-grandfather = прадед · great-uncle = дядя мамы или папы.

blocks.title: 🗣️ Произношение
blocks.note: В составных словах ударение на первом слове: MOther-in-law · STEPdaughter · GREAT-grandfather. И осторожно: niece /niːs/ — «нис», не «найс».

rows: Один человек → ’s: my cousin’s husband · Tom’s bike.
Мн. число на -s → только апостроф: my parents’ friends.
Неправильное мн. число → ’s: his children’s school · the men’s team.
Имя на -s: James’s car (читаем /ˈdʒeɪmzɪz/), допустимо и James’.
Общее владение → ’s только у второго: Tom and Anna’s house.
У каждого своё → ’s у обоих: Tom’s and Anna’s phones.
Про вещи обычно of: the door of the house.
I / you / we / they have got (’ve got) · he / she / it has got (’s got).
Отрицание: haven’t got / hasn’t got. Вопрос: Have you got…? · Has he got…?
Короткий ответ: Yes, I have. / No, he hasn’t.

blocks.title: 🎧 Аудирование
blocks.intro: Элла показывает подруге фотографию. Кто на ней? Слушай сколько угодно.
script: Is this an old photo, Ella?
Yes, it’s from my cousin’s wedding. That’s me on the left.
And who’s the woman next to you?
That’s Irina. She’s my father’s second wife, so she’s my stepmother.
She is. We get on well. And the little boy is Sasha, my half-brother. We’ve got the same dad.
He’s sweet! And the old lady in the blue dress?
That’s my great-grandmother, Vera. She’s ninety-one in that photo.
Ninety-one! Has she got a big family?
Enormous. Four children, eleven grandchildren and she can’t remember all our names!

blocks.title: 📕 Текст
blocks.html:
Every Friday evening the Novak family watches a sitcom together. Marek makes popcorn in the kitchen. His sister Ela chooses the episode. Their mum brings tea and their dad turns off his phone.

The family loves comedy, but everyone likes something different. Marek enjoys the clever jokes. Ela prefers the characters — she says they feel like real people. Their mum watches for the family scenes, and their dad just laughs at everything.

The episode finishes at nine o’clock. Then the family talks about it for twenty minutes. Marek always says the same thing: «Next Friday is too far away.»

blocks.title: 🎧 Аудирование
blocks.intro: Двое подростков обсуждают домашние дела. Слушай и отвечай.
script: My mum says I never help at home. That’s not true!
Really? What do you do, then?
I take out the rubbish. And I walk the dog every morning before school.
That’s two things, Ryan. My list is longer.
I make my bed, I set the table, and on Saturdays I do the ironing with my dad.
It’s not so bad. We talk while we do it. My brother loads the dishwasher, but he always forgets.
Does your mum do the washing?
Yes, but she says we share the housework. I think she does about half of it.
So do I. Mums always do more.
blocks.script_html:
Ryan: My mum says I never help at home. That’s not true!
Joanna: Really? What do you do, then?
Ryan: I take out the rubbish. And I walk the dog every morning before school.
Joanna: That’s two things, Ryan. My list is longer.
Ryan: Go on, then.
Joanna: I make my bed, I set the table, and on Saturdays I do the ironing with my dad.
Ryan: The ironing? Seriously?
Joanna: It’s not so bad. We talk while we do it. My brother loads the dishwasher, but he always forgets.
Ryan: Does your mum do the washing?
Joanna: Yes, but she says we share the housework. I think she does about half of it.
Ryan: So do I. Mums always do more.

q.q: What does Ryan do every morning?
How many jobs does Ryan mention?
When does Joanna do the ironing?

What does Joanna’s brother often forget?

blocks.title: 🎧 Диалог
blocks.intro: Трое подростков спорят, что смотреть. Послушай и разбери формы.
script: I don’t know. It’s a sitcom, I think. It’s really funny.
But Sarah and I want to watch the football! Barcelona against Chelsea.
But I hate sitcoms! And Tom doesn’t like sitcoms either.
Do you want to record the football, then?
We don’t want to record it, we want to watch it live! Give me the remote.
I haven’t got it. Does Mum know where it is?
It doesn’t matter. The match starts in two minutes.
blocks.script_html:
Sarah: What’s this on TV?
Jake: I don’t know. It’s a sitcom, I think. It’s really funny.
Tom: But Sarah and I want to watch the football! Barcelona against Chelsea.
Jake: I don’t like football.
Sarah: But I hate sitcoms! And Tom doesn’t like sitcoms either.
Jake: Do you want to record the football, then?
Sarah: We don’t want to record it, we want to watch it live! Give me the remote.
Jake: I haven’t got it. Does Mum know where it is?
Tom: It doesn’t matter. The match starts in two minutes.
Sarah: Found it! Right — football.

Who likes the sitcom?
What does Jake suggest?
Why doesn’t Sarah want to record it?

Do + I / you / we / they + глагол: Do you live near the school?
Does + he / she / it + глагол без -s: Does your friend like football?

blocks.title: 📕 Текст
blocks.h3: The family that runs on wheels
blocks.html:
The Ivanovs are a family of five from Riga, and they are famous online for one thing: bicycles. Anna, the mother, repairs old bikes in the garage. Her husband Pavel makes shelves and boxes for the tools. Their two daughters film everything, and their little son carries the knives, brushes and watches that people bring for repair.

«People send us photos of broken bikes from three countries,» says Anna. «We give away most of them to children who haven’t got one.» The family has fixed over four hundred bikes. Their lives are busy, but nobody complains — except about the dishes, which nobody wants to wash.

blocks.title: 📕 Стратегия чтения
blocks.html: Когда решаешь, какое предложение подходит в пропуск, читай и до, и после пропуска. Проверь три вещи: 1) есть ли смысл; 2) подходит ли грамматически (время, местоимения, единственное или множественное, this / that); 3) о том ли это, о чём абзац.

blocks.title: 📕 Текст с пропусками
blocks.h3: Brothers, sisters and the long war
blocks.html:
«Sometimes I want to be alone. But my sister is always there!»
«My brother takes my things and he doesn’t ask me first. I hate that!»

These complaints are not unusual. [1] ___ They argue about space, about noise, about who sat in the chair first. In general, teenagers are not very worried about their brothers and sisters when things go badly, and they are not very proud of them when things go well.

But most adults are keen on their brothers and sisters and have a good relationship. So when does the situation change? [2] ___ Maya is 28 and her brother Leo is 26. «I remember terrible fights,» says Maya. «But now it’s completely different. [3] ___ We meet two or three times a month and we always have a good time.»

So what can teenagers do while they wait? Learn to share. Give the other person time alone when they need it. Don’t tell people your brother’s or sister’s secrets. [4] ___

q.q: Пропуск [1]
o: Most teenagers have a difficult relationship with their brothers and sisters.
We get on well and we never argue.
Give your brother some time alone.

q.q: Пропуск [2]
o: Research suggests the answer is around the age of 25.
But other families are much smaller.

q.q: Пропуск [3]
o: We get on well and we don’t argue any more.
Teenagers are not proud of their siblings.

q.q: Пропуск [4]
o: And the other answer is simple: just wait ten years.
Most teenagers argue about space and noise.
Adults are keen on their brothers and sisters.
Многие подростки плохо ладят с братьями и сёстрами, но во взрослом возрасте отношения обычно налаживаются.
Все подростки прекрасно ладят с братьями и сёстрами.
Отношения остаются плохими и во взрослом возрасте.

items.q: How often do Maya and Leo meet now?
o: two or three times a month

proud of — гордиться · afraid of — бояться · tired of — устать от
keen on — увлекаться · interested in — интересоваться
nice / kind to — добр к · good at — хорош в · married to — женат на

blocks.h3: Two profiles from a school website
blocks.html:
Lauren
Hi! I’m Lauren and I’m seventeen. I’m in Year twelve at Northgate School. I live very near the school, so I walk to school in five minutes every morning.

I really enjoy school. My favourite subjects are science and art, and I’m keen on languages too. I’m quite hard-working, but my friends say I’m also creative.

I love films and I watch DVDs with my friends every weekend. My other hobbies are dancing and reading. I’ve got a dog and two cats — I love animals! My ambition is to be a vet.

James
Hello! My name’s James. I’m sixteen years old and I’m in Year eleven. I’ve got a brother in Year nine and I’ve got a stepsister too. She’s at university.

Music is important to me. I play the guitar and I write songs, but I’m not very patient, so I don’t practise every day. I’m friendly and quite talkative — maybe too talkative in lessons!

At the weekend I listen to music and I play football with my cousins. One day I want to study sound engineering.

rows: В личном профиле, письме другу и неформальном письме пиши сокращённо: I’m, she’s, I’ve got, don’t.

Абзац = два и больше предложений об одном. Новая тема — новый абзац.

blocks.title: ✍️ Твоя работа
blocks.html:
A personal profile. Напиши профиль о себе для школьного сайта — 100–130 слов, четыре абзаца.

План:
1. Имя, возраст, класс, где живёшь и как добираешься до школы.
2. Школа: любимые предметы, что даётся легко, что трудно.
3. Хобби и выходные: что делаешь, с кем.
4. Семья и питомцы + твоя мечта или цель.

Проверь перед сдачей:
• Везде ли сокращения (I’m, I’ve got, don’t)?
• Четыре абзаца, каждый — об одном?
• Два-три прилагательных характера про себя?
• Present simple: третье лицо с -s?
• Заглавные буквы у имён, стран и языков?

blocks.title: 💬 Перед письмом — проговори
items: Расскажи свой профиль вслух по плану, не записывая. Потом садись писать — так текст выйдет живее.
Прочитай написанное вслух. Там, где спотыкаешься, — там и надо править.
